purpose: Traceability for the runtime hardening pass that closed the repository review findings: operator authentication in front of the Observatory BFF, credential precedence in the Brain API, evidence deduplication and recomputed belief state, durable worker cognition, bounded tenant partitions, structured logging, and one canonical cockpit route surface.
rules: Every finding fixed here is covered by an executable regression test, not only by review.
Security-relevant defaults fail closed: absent configuration refuses requests rather than disabling the check.
Derived state (belief evidence fingerprints) is reconstructed from durable rows and never becomes a second source of truth.

code_module_records.schema: list envelope {items, total, source} over signals, edges, contradictions, curiosity tasks and sources projected from durable Brain state
code_module_records.runtime_service: apps.api.main, registered on the canonical FastAPI app served by Dockerfile
code_module_records.state_machine: durable event stream and belief store -> per-route read projection -> authenticated JSON list envelope
acceptance_criteria: the canonical Dockerfile image serves every collection route the Observatory client calls
every cockpit read route requires authentication
a client function added against a route the API never gained fails the suite
GET /signals reads the durable signal.enqueued event stream, not the evidence projection
code_module_records.source_preservation: route bodies moved verbatim from tools/live_cockpit_routes.py; the Vercel OIDC bridge remains in that module
unresolved_gaps: approvals, opportunities, outcomes, formula-runs and acceptance-reports answer with empty collections until the runtime populates them
the Dockerfile.railway entrypoint remains the only image carrying VercelOidcAuthBridge

code_module_records.schema: one JSON object per line carrying ts, level, logger, message, promoted extra fields and any exception traceback
code_module_records.runtime_service: brain.logging_config, configured by every Brain entrypoint
code_module_records.state_machine: unconfigured -> configure_logging attaches exactly one stderr handler to the brain logger tree -> get_logger returns namespaced loggers
acceptance_criteria: configuration is idempotent and never attaches a duplicate handler
no handler is attached to the root logger, so embedding an application is not hijacked
the continuous cognition loop reports every swallowed failure instead of passing silently
BRAIN_LOG_PROPAGATE forwards records to root when an aggregator needs them
code_module_records.source_preservation: new module; no prior logging configuration existed in the repository
unresolved_gaps: handlers that fall back to a computed default outside the cognition loop remain unlogged by design
